answers.question: What distinct checks should support make before calling every sign-in failure the same defect?
answers.expected_answer: Treat invitation handoff, password recovery, and SSO/IdP configuration as three separate evidence needs. Do not infer a shared root cause merely from sign-in symptoms.
answers.raw_model_answer:
Status: answered

Before grouping sign-in failures as one defect, support should check whether identity configuration is complete [V2-SUP-0086]; identify which workspaces are affected and whether the issue reproduces in a test workspace [V2-SUP-0086] [V2-SUP-0101]; inspect logs before attributing it to a release [V2-SUP-0086]; distinguish invalid credentials from an expired reset token [V2-SUP-0101]; and compare results across browsers and teammates [V2-SUP-0097].
answers.gist_answer: Before grouping sign-in failures as one defect, support should check whether identity configuration is complete [V2-SUP-0086]; identify which workspaces are affected and whether the issue reproduces in a test workspace [V2-SUP-0086] [V2-SUP-0101]; inspect logs before attributing it to a release [V2-SUP-0086]; distinguish invalid credentials from an expired reset token [V2-SUP-0101]; and compare results across browsers and teammates [V2-SUP-0097].

answers.question: How can an analyst separate missing live CRM records from a bad file upload?
answers.expected_answer: Check missing records in the live connector separately from one-time CSV/spreadsheet mapping errors. A green sync indicator cannot establish record completeness.
answers.raw_model_answer:
Status: partial

First establish whether the workflow was a live CRM sync or a one-time spreadsheet upload: feedback describes scrambled labels as an upload issue, while the PRD treats CSV mapping as separate from CRM integration reliability [V2-FB-0005] [prd-03]. For a live sync, compare the CRM’s records with the project view; one report says an account appeared in the CRM but not the project view [V2-FB-0100]. A missing record alone does not show whether Pulse skipped it or the CRM never sent it [V2-FB-0244].

Limitation: The evidence does not provide a diagnostic procedure or logs that establish which system caused a live-sync omission.
